purpose.description: The long-lived Team outcome and operating boundary.

goal.description: Desired outcome and external success signal.

task_graph_apply.description: Atomically apply the complete assigned Task graph. Omit expected_graph_version only for its first revision.

task_update.description: Apply one explicit Task transition or record current context. dependency_waiting and ready cannot be authored.

view.description: Snapshot restores context; updates returns one available page immediately.

model_role.description: Model role name; omit for the configured default on new Workers.

to.description: Worker name, or * for a Team announcement.

interrupt.description: Abort the recipient's current run first.

retryAt.description: Next automatic retry time in epoch milliseconds. Absence means no automatic retry.

delivery_degraded.description: Known delivery failures for this exact recipient generation. Retries use capped backoff. Absence does not prove presentation.

alert_id.description: Receipt identity shared with direct delivery; use it to recognize duplicates.

task_version.description: Historical Task version named by the sender; not current Task state.

text.description: Preview of at most 2000 Unicode code points. Ask the sender if the cut part matters.

text_length.description: Full body length in Unicode code points, present when truncated.

alerts.description: Newest first. from is sender member name; received_at is inbox receipt time, not send time. Recent is not unresolved. Use truncated, text_length and alerts_omitted to detect missing text. Ask the sender if cut or omitted text matters.

alerts_omitted.description: Older eligible received Alerts outside the newest-10 bound.

alerts_unavailable.description: Alert inbox read failed. Workers and Tasks remain current. Ask the human to inspect the inbox file.
